description: This file defines the Category entity class for a Java-based e-commerce application, mapping to a database table with JPA annotations. It manages category details such as descriptions, parent/child relationships, images, status, and audit info.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Represents a product category, including hierarchical structure, descriptions, status, and associated merchant store. It extends SalesManagerEntity and implements Auditable for CRUD and audit functionalities.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier (ID) of the category.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier (ID) of the category.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Retrieves the audit section containing audit info.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit section with audit info.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the list of category descriptions.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of category descriptions.

methods.name: getCategoryImage
methods.description: Gets the image URL or name associated with the category.

methods.name: setCategoryImage
methods.description: Sets the image URL or name for the category.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Retrieves the sort order value.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order value.

methods.name: isCategoryStatus
methods.description: Checks if the category is active/enabled.

methods.name: setCategoryStatus
methods.description: Sets the category status (active/inactive).

methods.name: isVisible
methods.description: Checks if the category is visible.

methods.name: setVisible
methods.description: Sets the visibility of the category.

methods.name: getDepth
methods.description: Returns the depth of the category in the hierarchy.

methods.name: setDepth
methods.description: Sets the depth of the category in the hierarchy.

methods.name: getLineage
methods.description: Retrieves the lineage string indicating hierarchy path.

methods.name: setLineage
methods.description: Sets the lineage string.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Gets the parent category.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Sets the parent category.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the associated MerchantStore.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a MerchantStore with this category.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Returns list of child categories.

methods.name: setCategories
methods.description: Sets the list of child categories.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the first description from the descriptions list, if available.
